slides.title: 售前工作的难点，不只是写PPT
design_actions: Turn six business difficulties into short problem labels before showing explanations.
Use a left vertical chain as the business spine and right-side expanded cards as evidence.
End with a strong bottom conclusion that reframes PPT as customer understanding, solution judgment, and expression design.

slides.title: AI介入售前的关键链路
design_actions: Place the five-step workflow as the top read path.
Split lower content into AI acceleration and human responsibility zones.
Make final responsibility visually stronger than AI generation.

slides.title: 交付Skill能力引擎
design_actions: Open with a visible equation strip: Skill equals role, context, template, rules, checklist, standards, and format.
Use a central capability engine as the protagonist.
Explain each component in a numbered list without letting the list dominate the engine.

slides.title: 典型交付Skill场景
design_actions: Use three stacked layers to show capability elevation.
Attach concrete Skill chips to each maturity level.
Use right-side quotations to translate each layer into delivery value.

slides.title: 把需求画出来
design_actions: Make the prototype screen the central evidence object.
Keep traditional text-demand pain points on the left and prototype validation values on the right.
Use bottom conclusion to make the artifact's role explicit: problems come from not drawing the requirement early enough.

slides.title: 从功能设计到可运行Demo
design_actions: Use input-process-output cards for the top explanation.
Show a pseudo product window and console as proof that the idea became a runnable demo.
Use small metrics to quantify startup-cost reduction and prototype output speed.
